about:
Car Parts New Haven operates as a used and pre-owned auto parts store in New Haven, Connecticut, serving the 06519 ZIP code area. The business caters to vehicle owners and mechanics who need replacement components due to accidents or long-term wear, and it ships parts to customers anywhere in the United States and Canada.

The company’s inventory focuses on used BMW parts alongside a broader selection of automotive components, and it also lists whole vehicles for sale. The store operates by appointment only, with phone lines open from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM on Sundays and 7:00 AM to 12:00 PM Monday through Saturday, offering 24/7 availability for inquiries through its website.

Its customer base includes both retail consumers and professional repair shops seeking affordable, reliable used parts. Online reviews reference specific transactions such as the purchase of a used battery, with customers noting the staff’s honesty and product knowledge.

According to the company, its reputation is built on competitive pricing, high-quality used parts, and top-tier customer service, which have generated extensive word-of-mouth recommendations. The business highlights its wonderful staff and commitment to customer satisfaction as the reasons customers return.
